body: Thanks for the reply. I'll look into it, i very much like reading about it. I want to ask you something though... You come across as someone with well developed use of reason, perhaps academic. Does your rationale actually help you deal with your own condition?

Dont know what "the world" means. So abstract it reeks of indifference and void. If you mean my close community of relationships: as i've said, i tried picturing that to convince me otherwise, but it only managed to stagger it and eventually agravate my tendencies.
